title: DOE using the alien motif as cover

tellings.quote: There's something going on with high energy physics, the Department of Energy, I think, throwing people off actually with this sort of alien motif,

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that something is going on with high energy physics at the Department of Energy, the US agency in charge of nuclear weapons and the national labs. He thinks the agency may be throwing people off by leaning on the idea of aliens, which would mean the UFO story is partly a cover for secret physics work.
